videos.title: Introduction to Materials
videos.description: All the material you have received with your kit is explained here.

videos.title: What to Expect?
videos.description: What to expect in the following videos and how things are organized and recordings created.

videos.title: Red Color Gajalakshmi
videos.description: Red-Color Gajalakshmi is introduced here. if you are createing the Plum color start from Painting Step1: First Coat video.

videos.title: Blue Color Gajalakshmi
videos.description: Blue-Color Gajalakshmi is introduced here. if you are createing the Plum color start from Painting Step1: First Coat video.

videos.title: Painting Clear Coat
videos.description: Learn to prep the canvas for painting. Applying a Clear Coat of Gesso is a very important step, do not skip. The Canvas should be FLAT before you start, so make sure you have weighted in on a flat surface for TWO(2) days.

videos.title: Painting Step1: First Coat
videos.description: Learn how to apply the first coat of paint.

videos.title: Mixing Without a Dropper
videos.description: Alternate paint mixing method without a dropper is shown here.

videos.title: End First Coat and Brush Cleaning
videos.description: See what my first coat looks like finished and clean your brushes the right way for proper maintenance.

videos.title: Detailing Brush and Painting Edges
videos.description: Use your detailing brush to paint the endges and details.

videos.title: Finished Look of the First Coat
Finished Look of the RED Gajalakshmi
Second Coat - Overnight Drying
videos.description: After the second coat is applied, let it dry overnight. Do not touch or move the canvas for at least 12 hours. The Video Captures the Velvet Smooth look after the drying time.

videos.title: Adding Gold -Part 1
videos.description: Learn to apply the gold paint to the Gajalakshmi painting. Key part are demonstrated, Continue as indicated.
